title: OpenSquilla
intro: OpenSquilla, headless over `opensquilla agent --json`, on an Anthropic-shaped provider through `$HOME/.opensquilla/config.toml`, where `api_key_env` names the credential's variable.
notes: Needs Python 3.12, hence the `py312` sandbox; installed from the wheel its GitHub release publishes.
`--session-id $HI_SESSION` with a session database in the member's home resumes across turns.
`--stateless-keep-project-rules` stops it seeding persona files into the workspace.
caveat: OpenSquilla prints its answer as one JSON line at the end of the turn, so a streamed response arrives as one chunk rather than many.
